name: The Luxa
description: The river whose blood-stained water recedes and leaves an empty riverbed.

pages_say.description: The river that flows by Naktamun.
The river where the crowds rush as the Hours begin and the Gate to the Afterlife lies.
The river flowing through Naktamun to the Gate, which the demon turns to blood.
The river that Razaketh has turned to blood, where Liliana is forced to wade and later raises dead animals.
The river turned to blood by Razaketh that now drains through the Gate.
The river whose blood-stained water recedes and leaves an empty riverbed.
The river that now runs blood red with fish corpses.
